description: This file contains unit tests for various AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) cipher implementations in BoringSSL, including test vectors, edge cases, and integration with Wycheproof test vectors.

classes.name: PerAEADTest
classes.description: Google Test fixture for testing different AEAD algorithms with various test vectors.

methods.name: TestVector
methods.description: Tests an AEAD implementation against predefined test vectors, including encryption, decryption, and error cases.

methods.name: TestExtraInput
methods.description: Tests AEAD sealing with extra input data.

methods.name: TestVectorScatterGather
methods.description: Tests AEAD scatter/gather APIs for encryption and decryption.

methods.name: CleanupAfterInitFailure
methods.description: Ensures cleanup works correctly after failed initialization.

methods.name: TruncatedTags
methods.description: Tests AEAD with truncated tags to verify correct handling of tag length truncation.

methods.name: AliasedBuffers
methods.description: Tests AEAD with overlapping input/output buffers to ensure correct in-place operation.

methods.name: UnalignedInput
methods.description: Tests AEAD with unaligned input buffers to verify correct handling of unaligned memory.

methods.name: Overflow
methods.description: Tests AEAD to ensure it does not overflow on large input sizes.

methods.name: InvalidNonceLength
methods.description: Tests AEAD with invalid nonce lengths to verify proper error handling.

methods.name: ABI
methods.description: Tests the ABI compatibility of AEAD context functions.
